item.title: Public transit creates health
item.description: New York City’s public transit system has gotten New Yorkers where they need to go and home again for over a century. For our public transit system to continue to move millions of people and to keep us healthy, it’s important to invest in its capacity, reliability, and accessibility to every New Yorker. Traffic is a huge part of our environment in New York City. In Manhattan’s central business district, the average car speed is under 7 miles per hour and has been getting slower over time.
